findings.summary: Using count on order_id skips null IDs, so the orders tally would be undercounted if order_id can be null; size() would count rows instead.
If customers["region"] is a categorical dtype, fillna("unknown") raises a TypeError because "unknown" is not an existing category.
A null or empty region for an existing customer is labelled "unknown", the same as a missing customer, which conflates two different cases.
